summary: Verified 'Nova firma' create-flow bug fixes (IRMS reCAPTCHA graceful UX + duplicate PIB friendly error + non-disabled form fields). Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass. Frontend: full Playwright flow passes all 7 assertions incl. friendly error mentioning existing firm name, editable fields, and successful unique-PIB creation with cleanup.

design_issues.screen: Nova firma modal - duplicate error banner
issues: Cosmetic: friendly error wraps the existing firm name in extra quotes, so when the DB name itself starts with a quote it renders as `""TAMIŠ" D.O.O. ULCINJ"` (double leading quote). Consider stripping surrounding quotes from the DB naziv or using a stylized chip instead of quoting.

action_items: OPTIONAL: strip leading/trailing quotes from firm naziv before embedding in duplicate-PIB error banner to avoid double-quote artifact when name already contains quotes (e.g. 'TAMIŠ').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L541-543: when IRMS returns a non-recaptcha non-200 status the message is 'IRMS portal vratio status {code}' — consider adding a hint to fill fields manually here too, mirroring the reCAPTCHA branch.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up TEST FIRMA UNIQUE DOO (PIB 99999123) and TEST FIRMA XYZ DOO (PIB 88888777) via API + UI. Nothing left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_companies_lookup.py covers: POST /api/companies with new PIB (99999123) → 200 + persistence GET; POST with existing PIB (02268400) → 400 with 'već postoji'; GET /api/companies/lookup-pib?pib=02268400 → 200 with success=false and message containing 'recaptcha/irms/portal/ručno' (fast, <15s); GET lookup-pib?pib=123 → 400 mentioning digit minimum. Frontend flow verified via Playwright using data-testids form-pib, form-naziv, form-adresa, form-grad, lookup-msg, form-error, save-company-btn, add-company-btn, login-username-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button. Auto-lookup debounce is 700ms.
rca_of_the_issue: IRMS portal (Poreska uprava CG) enabled reCAPTCHA v3 Enterprise, blocking headless/direct GET calls. Backend now short-circuits Playwright fallback (which required a missing chromium binary) and returns success=false with a clear message. Frontend save() detects 'već postoji' via case-insensitive substring match and rewrites the error to include the existing firm's naziv. Modal form fields are never disabled — only the lookup button reflects lookupBusy state — so users can always type manually while auto-lookup runs.
